VBO:0200328.summary: The Chi-Con, also called Chichon, is a Chihuahua–Bichon Frise cross. Documented examples include both first crosses and Bichon Frise backcrosses.
VBO:0200328.shortDescription: A Chihuahua–Bichon Frise cross, also called Chichon.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — Chi-Chon original parentage and litter accounts
sources.evidence: New entire page read: original Sebastion account specifies Chi-Chon mother from Chihuahua dam/Bichon Frise sire, then mother bred back to Bichon Frise. Original Sid litter account explicitly Chihuahua mother/Bichon Frise father and photographer keeper attribution. Names Chichon/Bichon Chi corroborate retained ontology. Juvenile anatomy and all temperament ignored.
